mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a federal funds rate above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit (RSAFS) exceeds $500 billion, it indicates strong household financial health and spending capacity, driving corporate revenue growth and resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals monetary policy tightening causing economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% month-over-month), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in demand away from housing, reducing economic momentum and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 1.5% and HOUST declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
